entities.name: Ernst Theodor Echtermeyer

entities.summary: Ernst Theodor Echtermeyer was a German writer and philosopher. Together with Arnold Ruge, in 1838, he founded the Hallische Jahrbücher für Wissenschaft und Kunst, an organ of the Young Hegelians.
